values: Conventional is fixed-gain PID. Intelligent is the NN payload estimate plus adaptive tail/gain logic.
Payload 0.2/0.5/0.7, gust 0.5/1.5, airspeed 12/20 m/s, 30 matched seeds, 15-second runs.
Each conventional/intelligent pair uses the same seed and scenario, so the disturbance realization is matched.
A run is valid only if it completes without the declared Euler, aerodynamic, or safety termination condition.
Lower maximum deviation, RMS error, altitude error/drop, and absolute steady-state error is better.
Lower average elevator, aileron, and rudder magnitude is generally better, but may trade against tracking quality.
Intelligent candidate means better valid rate and at least 5 of 9 tracking metrics. Mixed means no single controller dominates.
backend/results_grid_final/raw_runs.jsonl and grid_config.json; current source revision is hash-checked in the manifest.
These are simulation results under assumed aerodynamic parameters. They are not hardware or flight-test evidence.
